SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_items.ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND order_items.ordered_at < '2025-08-01' THEN order_items.product_price END) AS revenue_2025_07,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_items.ordered_at >= '2025-08-01' AND order_items.ordered_at < '2025-09-01' THEN order_items.product_price END) AS revenue_2025_08,
  100.0 * (
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_items.ordered_at >= '2025-08-01' AND order_items.ordered_at < '2025-09-01' THEN order_items.product_price END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN order_items.ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND order_items.ordered_at < '2025-08-01' THEN order_items.product_price END)
  ) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_items.ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND order_items.ordered_at < '2025-08-01' THEN order_items.product_price END), 0) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" AS order_items
WHERE order_items.ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND order_items.ordered_at < '2025-09-01'
